name: Datadog
tagline: A consolation build is possible, but the paid product's decisive value sits outside a solo rebuild. For Datadog, collect a bounded set of host metrics and logs into a self-hosted dashboard. The hard boundary is huge integration catalog, global ingestion, correlation, retention, security, and support, plus independent infrastructure and reliable alerting.
